kaikki_vikisozluk.e: طَبَاهَج or طَبَاهِج • (ṭabāhaj or ṭabāhij) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Middle Persian, continued as Classical Persian تباهه (tabāha).
g: a kind of stew of hashed meat and/or cut vegetables such as eggplants and peppers with herbs sautéd in oil with garlic and/or onions and includingh sour milk or eggs
